brief: Saudi Arabia: member Knowledge Economic City's shareholders approved renaming it Al-Jiwar Economic City (Argaam, 16 Nov), and its finance chief expects two of its Madinah shopping centres to start trading in 2027, one by the end of Q2 (Argaam, 13 Nov).
Kuwait: Alshaya opened 15 stores, among them H&M, Boots, Victoria's Secret and Shake Shack, for the official opening of Mabanee's Aventura Mall (Alshaya, 15 Nov).

Egypt: Majid Al Futtaim and DP World signed an MoU for a refrigerated produce route from Sokhna to Jebel Ali for MAF's UAE stores (Gulf News, 16 Nov), and Civilia launched STEEP Mall in Sheikh Zayed City with Asset Pillar as operator (Amwal Al Ghad, 8 Nov).

Pipeline and retailers: Izmir's Point Bornova is now YES Point Bornova under new investor YES Oto (AVM Dergi, 16 Nov), Dar Global plans a SAR 1bn mixed-use scheme in Jeddah (Dar Global, 16 Nov), and Al Othaim Markets lost SAR 39.26m in Q3 after problems with an ERP rollout (Argaam; Al Eqtisadiah, 10 Nov).
AI: etisalat launched AIO, an AI offer for businesses (Campaign Middle East, 16 Nov), and its investor deck targets 75% of UAE care calls deflected from human agents by 2031 (etisalat, 28 Oct).

findings.title: Knowledge Economic City shareholders approve renaming the company Al-Jiwar Economic City
findings.summary: An extraordinary general assembly of Knowledge Economic City, the Tadawul-listed Madinah developer, approved amending Article 2 of its bylaws to change the company's name to Al-Jiwar Economic City Company, Argaam reported on 16 Nov, the day after the meeting. The report gives the new name in Arabic only, and no official English form or attendance figure has been published yet. Shareholders had been called to vote on the change on 15 Nov (see 26 Oct).
findings.why: KEC develops Multaqa AlMadinah and Madinah Gate, so directory listings and event records for its Madinah schemes will need the new name once the official English form is out.

findings.entity: KEC shopping centres on King Abdulaziz Road and next to the train station
findings.title: Knowledge Economic City expects two Madinah shopping centres to start trading in 2027, one by the end of Q2
findings.summary: Knowledge Economic City's chief financial officer, Fahd Al-Zumai, told Asharq Bloomberg that two of its shopping centres, one on King Abdulaziz Road and one next to the train station, should start operating in 2027, that one is being prepared to open by the end of Q2 2027, and that leases have been signed for a major part of the commercial space (Argaam, 13 Nov). He also expects a new five-star hotel on King Abdulaziz Road to open in 2027 and targets the end of Q2 or the start of Q3 2027 for the Hilton residences. He did not name the centres or give their size.
findings.why: This is the first dated guidance on when KEC's Madinah malls will trade, and it bears on the openings printed for Multaqa AlMadinah and Madinah Gate, whose March 2024 date has passed.

findings.title: Alshaya opens 15 brand stores for the official opening of Kuwait's Aventura Mall
findings.summary: Alshaya Group says it opened 15 stores at Mabanee's new Aventura Mall in Jaber Al-Ahmad City to mark the mall's official opening, in a release dated 15 Nov. The readable copy names nine of them: H&M, Victoria's Secret, Bath & Body Works, Boots, Foot Locker, Starbucks, Shake Shack, Chipotle and Raising Cane's; the rest of the text sits behind a sign-up wall. Primark's second Kuwait store is due at the mall early in 2027 (Alshaya, 21 Oct), and the readable copy does not say whether Ulta Beauty, also in Alshaya's May agreement with Mabanee, has opened.
findings.why: Names the first Alshaya brands trading at Kuwait's newest mall, for the Aventura Mall tenant listing.

findings.entity: Majid Al Futtaim and DP World produce route
findings.title: Majid Al Futtaim and DP World plan a refrigerated route for Egyptian produce to MAF's UAE stores
findings.summary: Majid Al Futtaim Holding and DP World signed a memorandum of understanding at Mall of Egypt in Cairo to increase container shipments from Egypt to the UAE, starting with fresh fruit and vegetables: produce from MAF's Egyptian suppliers would be consolidated at DP World's temperature-controlled facilities in Sokhna, shipped from Sokhna Port and moved under refrigeration to Jebel Ali for distribution across MAF's retail network (Gulf News, 16 Nov). The partners gave no shipment target or start date and plan to add product categories and markets later. MAF Holding chief executive Ahmed Galal Ismail, who signed with DP World GCC chief executive Ahmad Yousef Al-Hassan, said the same day that the group has invested about USD 2.7 billion in Egypt (Amwal Al Ghad, over 30 years; Asharq Business says more than USD 2.7 billion since it entered the market).
findings.why: MAF owns Mall of Egypt and the City Centre malls and runs Carrefour, so its own cold chain from Egypt bears on fresh-food supply at the grocery anchors of its UAE malls.

findings.company: YES Oto (Gürbaşlar Grup); Esas Gayrimenkul (management and leasing)
findings.title: Point Bornova in Izmir becomes YES Point Bornova under new investor YES Oto, with Esas Gayrimenkul managing
findings.summary: AVM Dergi (16 Nov) reports that YES Oto, part of Gürbaşlar Grup and Enterprise's main representative in Türkiye, is the new investor in Point Bornova, which has renewed its brand identity as YES Point Bornova, with Esas Gayrimenkul running management and leasing. At a retail meeting in Istanbul, Adnan Başdemir, chairman of Gürbaşlar Grup and YES Oto, said the aim is a balanced brand mix with new categories and strong brands, and Esas Gayrimenkul COO Nevzat Yavan presented a two-year development plan. The report gives no takeover date, deal value or GLA.
findings.why: A new name, owner and manager at a listed Izmir mall changes what the directory prints, once the manager or a second outlet confirms it.

findings.company: Civilia Developments (developer); Asset Pillar (manager and operator)
findings.title: Civilia launches STEEP Mall in Sheikh Zayed City, with Asset Pillar to run it
findings.summary: Civilia Developments has launched STEEP Mall, a commercial, entertainment, office and medical project in the Golden Square area of Sheikh Zayed City, on three basement levels, a ground floor and four upper floors (Amwal Al Ghad, 8 Nov). Asset Pillar will manage and operate the project, E-Spaces the offices and Healthy Care the medical space, with ADC as consultant and designer. Chairman Mohamed Gad said about 80% of the construction work is finished before any units are offered for sale; no delivery date is given, and the investment and floor areas reported rest on one outlet so far.
findings.why: A small mixed-use mall in West Cairo with an operator named at launch: a candidate for the Egypt pipeline once its size and delivery date are confirmed.

findings.entity: Dar Global mixed-use development, Jeddah (name not published)
findings.title: Dar Global buys Jeddah land for a SAR 1 billion mixed-use scheme, with no retail element disclosed
findings.summary: London-listed Dar Global has announced plans for a mixed-use development in Jeddah with an estimated gross development value of about SAR 1 billion (USD 267 million), on land acquired for about USD 56 million, which will bring an unnamed international luxury brand to the city through a co-branded residential concept (Dar Global release and The National, both 16 Nov). The release gives no project name, site, land area or retail component, and says the concept and launch date will follow. The purchase is part of a programme to expand its Saudi portfolio by up to SAR 4 billion, with more land acquisitions to be announced shortly.
findings.why: Another Jeddah mixed-use scheme for the pipeline, but it stays a watch item until Dar Global names the site and any retail space.

sources.outlet: Dar Global release (PR Newswire, TradingView copy)

findings.title: Al Othaim Markets posts a SAR 39.26m Q3 loss, blaming lower sales after an ERP system rollout
findings.summary: Abdullah Al Othaim Markets reported a net loss of SAR 39.26 million for Q3 2026, against a net profit of SAR 17.48 million a year earlier, and a nine-month net loss of SAR 92.73 million, against a profit of SAR 134.98 million (Argaam and Al Eqtisadiah, both 10 Nov). The Q3 loss is narrower than Q2's SAR 107.13 million. The company attributes the results to lower sales linked to operational and technical problems with its ERP system rollout and to changes in consumer behaviour and the market, plus higher inventory provisions and e-commerce costs.
findings.why: Al Othaim is a large grocery anchor in Saudi community and neighbourhood centres, and its swing to losses after a systems rollout is a watch point for its landlords.

findings.title: etisalat launches AIO for businesses and targets 75% of UAE care calls deflected from human agents by 2031
findings.summary: etisalat unveiled etisalat AIO at its AI Innovation Day at Bluewaters in Dubai on 16 Nov: an ecosystem of what it calls 10 capability stacks, from AI data centres, compute and a token factory to edge AI, security, agentic AI and robotics, for businesses to run AI on sovereign infrastructure; no customers were named (Campaign Middle East, 16 Nov). The group's Capital Markets Day deck of 28 Oct sets 2031 targets for etisalat UAE of 75% of calls deflected from human agents, a 30-50% cut in average handling time and a 5-point NPS gain, and reports an NPS of +78 at launch for its AI voice agents. The deck also says its first conversational AI open to the public is live on its customer-care numbers.
findings.why: A leading UAE telco now sells AI infrastructure and agents to businesses and has put numbers on AI in its own contact centres, a benchmark for MECSC's customer-service community.

findings.title: Commerce rolls out Shopping Agent, a brandable AI assistant for BigCommerce storefronts
findings.summary: Commerce, the company behind BigCommerce, began rolling out Shopping Agent to eligible BigCommerce merchants on 16 Nov, ahead of the holiday selling season: a storefront AI assistant that merchants can customise with their own branding to guide shoppers. Conversational storefront search is now available on all paid BigCommerce plans, and a B2B Agent for purchase-order workflows is in early access. The release names no regions, saying only that the product will expand to more regions and verticals over time.
findings.why: Retailer-owned AI shopping assistants are becoming a standard e-commerce platform feature, a way for Gulf retailers to keep shopping conversations on their own sites as outside agents spread.

library.title: New Horizon Strategy: AI-powered and AI enabling Global Telco Group (Capital Markets Day 2026)
library.note: PDF opened (about 77 slides). The group's AI strategy: the AIO 'Intelligence Orchestrator', which it calls its proprietary sovereign intelligence layer; 2031 targets for etisalat UAE of 75% of calls deflected from human agents, a 30-50% cut in average handling time and a 5-point NPS gain; AI voice agents at +78 NPS on launch; and its first public conversational AI on customer-care numbers. Benchmark material for MECSC sessions on AI in contact centres.

watch.item: Saudi security situation: flights, events and mall trading
watch.note: King Khalid International, Riyadh, resumed operations on 17 Oct after the 10 Oct attack, with each flight still needing GACA permission (Gulf Business, 20 Oct). Suspensions reported on 20 Oct: Etihad Riyadh and Dammam, Air India and IndiGo to 24 Oct; Akasa Air to 27 Oct; Air France-KLM Riyadh to 7 Nov; Lufthansa Group to 18 Nov; Philippine Airlines to 29 Nov; Cathay Pacific to 31 Jan 2027; Delta's Atlanta-Riyadh flights to March 2027; Qatar Airways' Riyadh and Dammam flights and Gulf Air's Riyadh services have no restart date. Malaysia Airlines resumed Jeddah and Madinah on 18 Oct. FII10, the Saudi Retail Forum and Intersec Saudi Arabia have moved to 2027; the FII Institute has set 25 to 28 Oct 2027 for FII10 (Arabian Business, 12 Nov; see 13 Nov) and Riyadh Fashion Week was postponed on 14 Oct (Arab News). Kingdom Centre has moved its office tenants to remote working while its mall stays open (AFP, 18 Oct). Riyadh Season was due to open on 21 Oct; no dated report of the opening had been found by 2 Nov. Check effects on Riyadh mall trading, Westfield Riyadh's Q4 opening and travel to RCM Jeddah (7 to 8 Dec). Nahdi Medical cut its 2026 profit forecast on 29 Oct, citing geopolitical pressures. Nothing found by 4 Nov on Riyadh mall trading or on travel to RCM Jeddah

watch.note: No GCC bank, payment network or retailer had set rules to admit or block outside AI shopping agents by 16 Nov. New: OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet lets its dots agents complete purchases with tokenised cards and Face ID or fingerprint approval for each purchase, first for some US Pro subscribers, and OpenAI published a Commerce Partner Playbook for retailers (TechCrunch, 13 Nov; see 16 Nov). Also: OpenAI's Businesses in ChatGPT lets companies claim their profiles and add product feeds, with Business Agents first for US online sellers (Reuters, 10 Nov; see 12 Nov). Also: CrediMax and Mastercard will explore agentic commerce for Bahrain merchants, starting with Mastercard's Agent Suite for Merchants (Mastercard, 4 Nov; see 10 Nov), and Zalando launched an agent that buys from other retailers inside its app (Reuters, 3 Nov; see 10 Nov). Earlier context: American Express's Intent Intelligence framework (13 Oct), Meta and Sierra's Personal Agent Protocol (14 Oct), Amazon and eBay blocking agents (16 Oct), Walmart's Agent Gateway (21 Oct), US banks restricting third-party agents (23 Oct), BCG's survey of large retailers (21 Oct, see 28 Oct), PYMNTS and Visa on UAE merchants' readiness (26 Oct), Meta's Muse (28 Oct), Home Depot's rules for agents (29 Oct), Retail Dive's holiday survey round-up (3 Nov), and Amazon's Alexa for Shopping for outside merchants (4 Nov) and text-to-shop test (6 Nov)
watch.source: TechCrunch, 13 Nov 2026; Reuters, 10 Nov 2026; Mastercard, 4 Nov 2026
